Logging and console output

Source: R/config_objects.R
logger.Rd

logger mirrors upstream's manim.logger: logger$info("..."), logger$debug(), logger$warning(), logger$error() and logger$critical() print a message when its level is at least the verbosity setting of manim_config() ("DEBUG", "INFO", "WARNING", "ERROR" or "CRITICAL"; default "INFO"). Messages go through message(), so suppressMessages() silences them. logger$setLevel() changes verbosity. Format arguments work as in sprintf().

Usage

logger

console

error_console

cli_ctx_settings

Format

Lists of functions; cli_ctx_settings is a named list.

Details

console$print() writes to standard output and error_console$print() to standard error, like upstream's rich consoles.

cli_ctx_settings holds upstream's command line help settings (the [CLI_CTX] section of its configuration file).

Examples

logger$info("Rendering %d scenes", 2L)
#> INFO Rendering 2 scenes
console$print("Done")
#> Done
